rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the tetragonal d-wave altermagnet Hall viscosity (8.41 vs ~10 hbar/v_uc, ~13% difference on physical units), confirms the phi-proportionality and equal-sign d-wave relation. However, the g-wave 3D model (Fig. 4), which is a co-equal headline result, was not implemented at all. The shear-coupling convention required anchoring to the paper's stated magnitude rather than independent derivation. Coverage is limited to roughly half the paper's central claims (d-wave only), though agreement on what was tested is strong.
